fields.name: ArgentSeaDbPersistenceOptionsValidator<TDatabaseOptions> validation surface
fields.contract: A caller constructs ArgentSeaDbPersistenceOptionsValidator<TDatabaseOptions> with a persistence registration name, OrleansDbPersistenceOptions, and a database service entry. ValidateConfiguration returns only when the options exist, DatabaseKey is nonempty and equals the registration name, Queries is non-null and nonempty, and the database entry has nonempty read and write connection strings; otherwise it throws OrleansConfigurationException.
